description: Hand-labelled small diagnostic set, not a representative production benchmark.

knowledge.title: SQLite concurrency
knowledge.content: Use WAL journal_mode for SQLite concurrent readers. Keep transactions short.

knowledge.title: PowerShell encoding
knowledge.content: Use UTF-8 for PowerShell JSON output and Python file reads.

knowledge.title: Project scope isolation
knowledge.content: Filter memory by project_key before retrieval; user scope is explicitly shared.

knowledge.title: HTTP timeout handling
knowledge.content: Set connect and read timeouts for HTTP requests. Retry only idempotent requests.

knowledge.title: DPI replay acceptance
knowledge.content: Validate DPI with positive PCAP hits and negative PCAP false positives; compilation alone is insufficient.

knowledge.title: SSH direction fields
knowledge.content: SSH req fields describe client requests; rsp fields describe server responses. Match field.ini and replay evidence.

knowledge.title: Context budget
knowledge.content: Limit injected memory tokens; omit irrelevant items rather than truncating their instructions.

knowledge.title: Secret redaction
knowledge.content: Redact API credentials and passwords before persistence. Never store raw secrets.

knowledge.title: Stale evidence
knowledge.content: A stale artifact unchanged since the task began does not prove fresh validation.

knowledge.title: Negative retrieval
knowledge.content: Zero recall is acceptable for unrelated queries. Do not force a knowledge match.
